column1: # Regression check for a33fa42bc3, which changes the host depth format for
# every Z24S8 surface. Two suites with no depth captures at all, re-run on the
# same device and compared byte for byte against their pre-change captures.
# The one differing capture moved by a single pixel against the golden
# (37,445 -> 37,446 of 307,200), which is run-to-run noise, not the change.
